title: 第1章 欢迎您的到来勇者大人第2章 这个勇者是魔鬼
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
小默，我跟你大姑他们借了两万块，我不会用手机转账，跟他们说先转给你，你记得收一下。
好的。
……
大姑（转账25000元）：对了，你妈在哪个病房来着？
……
同事王哥（转账3000元）：记得下个月还啊，我还要还房贷呢。
……
泡面（转账10000元）：兄弟你先用着，我这不着急还。
……
看着手机里的聊天记录，林默深吸了一口气。
老妈半年前确诊肝癌，从那开始他和老爸就在没日没夜打工。
加上今天借来的这些钱，已经攒够123300元了。
这些钱在加上家里之前的积蓄，手术费的钱就够了。
虽然后续靶向药的钱仍然是个问题，不过最起码眼前的麻烦算是解决了。
想到这林默不由得看向窗外。
城中村的街道上并不算冷清，十点以后仍然有不少摆摊的小贩。
突然，他好像想起了什么。
起身走到书架旁。
书架上有一个显眼的照片，那是老妈确诊当天照的。
照片旁边放着一个文件袋，将文件袋拿了出来。

抽出里面最上面的几张报告纸。
纸面上那几个加粗的汉字，冲散了林默些许疲惫。
【临床诊断：肝细胞癌（hcc）】
上面的各项数值他几乎能背下来。
明天就要去医院交钱了，这份诊断书也必须带上。
这么想着，林默就要将检查报告放在床头上。
确保明天一早醒来就能看到。
就在这时，林默只觉得脑子一晕。
不过这感觉来得快去得也快。
他手里拿着检查报告站在原地缓了半晌，随后苦笑了一声。
“今天打了三份工，确实有点累了。”
他话音刚落，脚下毫无征兆的亮起了一道蓝光。
林默低头瞪大眼睛看去，难道自己累出幻觉了？
还没等他反应过来，蓝光中传来一阵巨大的吸力，直接把他整个人都吸了进去。
等一切结束的时候，房间回归寂静。
只是林默、手机、诊断书不见了。
……
砰！
不知过了多久，沉重的撞击感传来，伴随着骨头与坚硬地面接触的闷响。
剧痛从着地的部位蔓延开，让林默眼前发黑。

眩晕感持续了好几秒，他才艰难地抬起头。
刺目的光线让他下意识地眯了眯眼睛。
等视野清晰，他愣住了。
眼前的场景竟然变成了一个教堂。
这个教堂不大，许多细节都显露出破败和节省的痕迹。
content_en:
Xiao Mo, I borrowed 20,000 yuan from your aunt and the others. I didn’t know how to transfer money using my mobile phone. I told them to transfer it to you first and you remember to collect it.
OK
…
Aunt (transferring 25,000 yuan): By the way, which ward is your mother in?
…
Colleague Brother Wang (transferred 3,000 yuan): Remember to pay it back next month. I still have to pay off my mortgage.
…
Instant noodles (transfer 10,000 yuan): Brother, you can use it first, I’m not in a hurry to return it.
…
Looking at the chat history on his phone, Lin Mo took a deep breath.
His mother was diagnosed with liver cancer six months ago, and since then he and his father have been working day and night.
Including the money borrowed today, we have saved 123,300 yuan.
This money, combined with the family's previous savings, will be enough for the surgery.
Although the cost of subsequent targeted drugs is still a problem, at least the immediate trouble is solved.
Thinking of this, Lin Mo couldn't help but look out the window.
The streets of the urban village are not deserted. There are still many vendors setting up stalls after ten o'clock.
Suddenly, he seemed to remember something.
Get up and walk to the bookshelf.
There is a prominent photo on the bookshelf, which was taken on the day my mother was diagnosed.
There was a document bag next to the photo, and he took out the document bag.
Pull out the top few report papers inside.
The bold Chinese characters on the paper dispersed Lin Mo's fatigue.
[Clinical diagnosis: hepatocellular carcinoma (hcc)]
He can almost memorize all the values above.
I have to go to the hospital tomorrow to pay, and I must bring this medical certificate with me.
Thinking like this, Lin Mo was about to put the inspection report on the bedside.
Make sure you wake up early tomorrow morning and see it.
At this moment, Lin Mo felt dizzy.
But this feeling comes and goes as quickly as it comes.
He stood there for a long time with the inspection report in his hand, and then gave a wry smile.
"I worked three jobs today, so I'm really tired."
As soon as he finished speaking, a blue light lit up under his feet without any warning.
Lin Mo lowered his head and looked with wide eyes. Could it be that he was hallucinating from exhaustion?
Before he could react, a huge suction force came from the blue light, sucking his entire body in.
When it was all over, the room returned to silence.
But Lin Mo, his cell phone, and the medical certificate were missing.
…
Bang!
I don't know how long it took, but there was a heavy impact, accompanied by the muffled sound of bones contacting the hard ground.
Severe pain spread from the area where he hit the ground, making Lin Mo's eyesight turn black.
The dizziness lasted for several seconds before he raised his head with difficulty.
The dazzling light made him squint his eyes subconsciously.
When his vision became clear, he froze.
The scene in front of me turned into a church.
The church is not large, and many details show signs of dilapidation and frugality.
